tasks.label: Build Debug
tasks.command: GEN=ninja BUILD_BENCHMARK=1 BUILD_TPCH=1 BUILD_TPCDS=1 BUILD_HTTPFS=1 CORE_EXTENSIONS='tpch' EXTRA_CMAKE_VARIABLES='-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=-DExactLeftDeep' make debug -j $(nproc)

tasks.label: Build Release
tasks.command: GEN=ninja BUILD_BENCHMARK=1 BUILD_TPCH=1 BUILD_TPCDS=1 BUILD_HTTPFS=1 CORE_EXTENSIONS='tpch' EXTRA_CMAKE_VARIABLES='-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=-DExactLeftDeep' make release -j $(nproc)

tasks.label: Build Release (with thc timers)
tasks.command: GEN=ninja BUILD_BENCHMARK=1 BUILD_TPCH=1 BUILD_TPCDS=1 BUILD_HTTPFS=1 CORE_EXTENSIONS='tpch' EXTRA_CMAKE_VARIABLES='-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=-DExactLeftDeep' CXXFLAGS='-DDUCKDB_ENABLE_HASH_JOIN_TIMERS=1' make release -j $(nproc)

tasks.label: RS on ASH-datagen Case 3
tasks.command: cd /mnt/local_ssd/spy; GEN=ninja BUILD_BENCHMARK=1 BUILD_TPCH=1 BUILD_TPCDS=1 BUILD_HTTPFS=1 CORE_EXTENSIONS='tpch' EXTRA_CMAKE_VARIABLES='-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=-DExactLeftDeep' make release -j $(nproc); ./scripts/measure/run_ash_datagen_release.sh --case 3 rs
